title: EIP-8359: Beacon Block Reporting Field
description: Adds a beacon block body field for validator client and setup reporting.
author: hanniabu (@hanniabu), Luca Winter (@eth2353), Paul Harris (@rolfyone)
laymanDescription: Nobody knows which clients validators actually run. Today it is guessed from fingerprinting, crawlers, relays, or graffiti conventions, all of which are unreliable. This proposal adds a 32-byte field to the block where a proposer can state its consensus client, execution client, and setup type.
benefits: Gives client diversity a purpose-built field instead of competing with custom graffiti
Encodes a client pair in one byte, so block size grows by 32 bytes
Records multinode and distributed validator setups, which graffiti watermarks cannot
tradeoffs: Reports are unverifiable, so the data cannot back rewards, penalties, or fork choice
Rare client and setup combinations become more identifiable to observers
Data only updates when a validator proposes, so aggregates lag reality
